title: [Bug]: AMF assertion failure in curl_multi_add_handle during shutdown after SIGTERM

labels.name: triage
labels.description: Triage label for new issues and feature requests

body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.8.0

### Steps to reproduce

1.Start the Open5GS network functions, including AMF and NRF.

2.Run AFLNet against the AMF's NGAP interface.

3.Send SIGTERM to the AMF at the end of a test iteration.

4.Check the AMF shutdown logs.

[id 001716,src 000071+000029,op splice,rep 128.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34422474/id.001716.src.000071%2B000029.op.splice.rep.128.zip)

### Expected behaviour

After receiving SIGTERM, the AMF should handle pending SBI operations and terminate without triggering a fatal assertion.

### Observed Behaviour

After receiving SIGTERM, the AMF began termination and attempted to add an SBI request to a libcurl multi handle. curl_multi_add_handle() returned a non-zero value, which Open5GS logged as CURLM_unknown. The subsequent call to mcode_or_die() triggered a fatal assertion.

### eNodeB/gNodeB

AFLNet was used to send NGAP test messages to the AMF.

### UE Models and versions

Not specified.
